data.title: Heavyweight Tee — Sage
data.sizes: XS, S, M, L, XL, XXL

$media.alt: Light green t-shirt with cotton branches

data.summary: Boxy, 260 gsm, built to be worn for years.

children.text: A heavier 260 gsm cotton with a slightly boxy, dropped-shoulder silhouette. Holds its shape wash after wash and gets better with age. Sage is a muted green that works with everything.
Fabric: 100% organic ringspun cotton, 200 gsm, garment-dyed and pre-shrunk. Machine wash cold, tumble dry low. Unisex fit — see the size guide for measurements.
